title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → ExperientialLearning
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.
